subject: Sync Playbook — hand-off windows for multi-TZ demo deep-dive
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Byrne <alex.byrne@heliumhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mediwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sync Playbook — hand-off windows for multi-TZ demo deep-dive

Hi Alex / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful to get a clearer read on Helium Health's priorities. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for inference at scale for clinical summarization (low-latency, data retention controls).
- Constraints: hybrid deployment (VPC), strict audit logs, and staggered on-call across APAC/EU/US.

Recommended next step: technical deep dive (60–75 minutes) with engineering + infra owners. To make scheduling predictable for your teams and ours, we're proposing a weekly rotating window (US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening) so each region occasionally gets a favorable hour.

Proposed pattern (first two weeks examples — all times in local zone):
- Week A (US lead): Tue 09:00 PT / Tue 17:00 GMT / Wed 01:00 SGT — Redwood leads, Helium Health optional for APAC.
- Week B (EU lead): Wed 15:00 GMT / Wed 07:00 PT / Thu 23:00 SGT — Helium Health leads, Redwood follows.

Candidate slots this month (pick up to 2):
- Mar 23, 2027 — Tue 09:00 PT / 17:00 GMT
- Mar 24, 2027 — Wed 15:00 GMT / 08:00 PT
- Mar 25, 2027 — Thu 22:00 SGT / 06:00 GMT

Duration: 60–75 minutes. Attendees we suggest: your Platform/Infra lead, your ML engineering lead, our Solution Architect (Marissa), and me.

Attachments: Discovery-MAP.xlsx (covers scope + must-haves). I also included a Calendly link below to lock a slot; if you'd rather I send a calendar invite that reflects the rotation pattern, say the word and I'll draft recurring invites.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-deepdive

Quick ask: which of the candidate slots works for you? Also confirm who from your side will join the technical deep dive.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Discovery-MAP.xlsx
From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@heliumhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mediwise.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T17:22:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Sync Playbook — hand-off windows for multi-TZ demo deep-dive

Thanks Markus — great summary.

We can do Wed 15:00 GMT (Mar 24). That works best for our EU engineering lead (Clara). A couple of Qs:
- Can you make the session more hands-on (not just slides)? Our ML lead wants to see perf numbers on sequences ~1k tokens and how KV cache is handled.
- Ideal attendance: myself, Clara (PL), and our CTO (I'm looping him depending on timing).

If you can send a recurring invite that follows your rotation pattern, that's ideal — we can mark which weeks we can host.

Alex
Alex Byrne
Head of Platform | Helium Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sync Playbook — hand-off windows for multi-TZ demo deep-dive

Thanks for confirming, Alex — Wed 15:00 GMT / 08:00 PT on Mar 24 is locked tentatively.

We can absolutely make this hands-on. Outline proposal for the deep dive:
1) 10m intro + scope
2) 20–25m live demo (model infra, quantization modes, KV cache walkthrough)
3) 20–25m perf + deployment Q&A (1k token profile, latency cost tradeoffs)
4) 10m next steps / rollout options

Logistics: Markus will run the demo; I'll bring the evaluation checklist (will attach SLA-draft for your procurement). Markus — if this slot works, can you draft the recurring invite with 1:2 rotation (Redwood lead then Helium lead) and include a shared note template for runbooks?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mediwise.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@heliumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T02:11:00+10:00
Subject: Re: Sync Playbook — hand-off windows for multi-TZ demo deep-dive

On behalf of MediWise (we're helping Helium Health on infra), APAC evenings are easiest for us. If you're rotating, happy to take the APAC-friendly slot every third week.

Also — will you record and share slides + a short recording? Our CTO can't always attend live.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Integration Lead | MediWise
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Byrne <alex.byrne@heliumhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mediwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sync Playbook — hand-off windows for multi-TZ demo deep-dive

Great — thanks everyone.

Confirmed: Technical deep dive — Mar 24, 2027 at 15:00 GMT / 08:00 PT (60–75m). I'll send a recurring invite that encodes a 3-week rotation: Week 1 (Redwood lead, US morning), Week 2 (Helium lead, EU afternoon), Week 3 (APAC evening hosted by MediWise), then repeat. I'll include recording + slide deck in the invite and attach the SLA-draft for procurement.

Links & artifacts:
- Calendly (single-use): https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-deepdive
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B0example
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HLTH-2027-092

Attachments: Discovery-MAP.xlsx; SLA-draft.pdf

If anyone needs a different cadence, tell me in this thread within 48 hours and we'll adjust before I publish the recurring invites.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
